While logged in as an admin navigate to Configuration> System> API which loads the API v3 section where you find existing API keys or add a new one.

result.notes: API key is the only documented auth method (no OAuth2/basic/bearer mentioned in support docs). API access is bundled with paid subscription tiers, but LiveAgent offers a 30-day free trial with no credit card required, during which admins can generate API keys via Configuration > System > API. Full interactive REST API v3 docs are only visible inside a live account (https://YOURDOMAIN.ladesk.com/docs/api/v3/), so exact endpoint count (api_breadth) could not be verified externally. The only MCP server found is published under QualityUnit's own GitHub org (QualityUnit is LiveAgent's parent company), so treated as vendor/official, though the README frames it as a custom-dev example rather than a fully supported product — some uncertainty here.
result.one_liner: LiveAgent is a helpdesk/live-chat support platform offering a REST API (v3) for tickets, contacts, and agent operations.
